speaker: Unknown
en: How do you decide what to put where?
zh: 你如何决定什么放在哪里?

speaker: Unknown
en: For most enterprise AI systems, the interesting engineering problem is not the model itself.
zh: 对于大多数企业级 AI 系统来说,有趣的工程问题不是模型本身。

speaker: Unknown
en: The model consumes tokens and produces tokens.
zh: 模型消费 token,产出 token。

speaker: Unknown
en: Your knowledge lives in files, databases, and APIs.
zh: 你的知识存在于文件、数据库和 API 中。

speaker: Unknown
en: The key architecture decision is how that knowledge reaches inference.
zh: 关键的架构决策是:这些知识如何到达推理。

speaker: Unknown
en: From the prompt or the context, through the retrieval or memory layer, or by model adaptations such as fine tuning.
zh: 是通过提示词或上下文,通过检索或记忆层,还是通过微调之类的模型适配手段。

speaker: Unknown
en: Today, I'm going to argue that this is a decision that most enterprise teams make by accident.
zh: 今天,我要论证的是:大多数企业团队是靠偶然做出这个决策的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the path to making it on purpose is to recognize that this is not a ladder that you climb.
zh: 而有意识地做出这个决策的路径,是认识到这不是一个你可以往上爬的梯子。

speaker: Unknown
en: These are three different tools for three different jobs.
zh: 这是三把不同的工具,对应三个不同的工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: So how is this an accident?
zh: 那么这怎么会是偶然呢?

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, there are two mechanisms.
zh: 嗯,有两种机制。

speaker: Unknown
en: One is the obvious one.
zh: 一种是显而易见的。

speaker: Unknown
en: The other one, not so much.
zh: 另一种就没那么明显了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the obvious one is that teams escalate.
zh: 显而易见的那种是团队在逐级升级。

speaker: Unknown
en: You don't get the right answer from your model.
zh: 你没有从模型那里得到正确的答案。

speaker: Unknown
en: The easy thing is go put something in the prompt, like go fix the prompt.
zh: 最简单的做法是往提示词里放点东西,比如去修一下提示词。

speaker: Unknown
en: Still wrong?
zh: 还是错?

speaker: Unknown
en: Maybe there is something with the memory system or the retrieval system.
zh: 也许是记忆系统或检索系统有问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's take a look there.
zh: 我们去看看那里。

speaker: Unknown
en: Even then, if you're wrong, hey, you know what?
zh: 即便如此,如果你还是不对,嘿,你知道吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's fine tune the model.
zh: 我们来微调一下模型吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: Doesn't happen very often, but yes, sometimes teams reach out to fine tune the model.
zh: 这种情况不常发生,但是的,有时团队确实会去微调模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: There is a layer underneath it.
zh: 在这之下还有一层。

speaker: Unknown
en: The teams that are not escalating are still making these decisions every day.
zh: 那些没有逐级升级的团队,其实每天都在做这些决策。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every edit that you make to the prompt decides what behavior lives in the prompt.
zh: 你对提示词做的每一次编辑,都决定了什么行为存在于提示词中。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every document that you index decides what knowledge is held in the memory.
zh: 你索引的每一份文档,都决定了什么知识被保存在记忆中。

speaker: Unknown
en: And every training sample that you bake in
zh: 而你固化进去的每一个训练样本——

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, every training sample that you identify will bake something into the weights.
zh: 嗯,你选定的每一个训练样本,都会把某些东西固化进权重。

speaker: Unknown
en: All these are architecture decisions.
zh: 这些全都是架构决策。

speaker: Unknown
en: None call like that.
zh: 但没有一个被这样对待。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let me make it a little concrete for you all.
zh: 让我给大家讲得具体一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I've seen this play out, actually.
zh: 实际上,我见过这样的情形上演。

speaker: Unknown
en: An internal support assistant just released.
zh: 一个内部支持助手刚刚发布。

speaker: Unknown
en: In a few weeks, the product manager makes some changes to the prompt to fix the tone of the support assistant.
zh: 几周后,产品经理对提示词做了一些修改,来修一修这个支持助手的语气。

speaker: Unknown
en: After a few weeks, the support team adds refund policy documents to your retrieval on memory systems.
zh: 又过了几周,支持团队把退款政策文档加进了你的检索或记忆系统。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll talk about retrieval and memory.
zh: 我会讲检索和记忆。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm treating it all as memory, but I'll come to that.
zh: 我把这两者都当作记忆来处理,不过我稍后会回到这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then, since your agent is not giving you the right answers, an engineer
zh: 然后,由于你的智能体没有给你正确的答案,一位工程师

speaker: Unknown
en: Shuffs the product catalog into the prompt.
zh: 把产品目录塞进了提示词。

speaker: Unknown
en: And after a few weeks, the machine learning team decides to train the model or fine tune the model on support tickets from six months ago, from up to six months ago.
zh: 几周后,机器学习团队决定用过去六个月内、最多追溯到六个月前的支持工单来训练模型或微调模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: All decisions look fine, look OK, except one, by the way.
zh: 所有这些决策看起来都没问题,看起来都还行——顺便说一句,除了一条。

speaker: Unknown
en: But even I have made such decisions in my journey.
zh: 但即使是我,在自己的历程中也做过这样的决策。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have made such decisions of doing such things without really giving it a lot of thought.
zh: 我做过这类事情,却并没有真正深思熟虑过。

speaker: Unknown
en: So when the new product catalog is launched, it looks easy, right?
zh: 所以,当新的产品目录发布时,这看起来很简单,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: Oh, the engineer has shoved the product catalog into the prompt.
zh: 哦,工程师把产品目录塞进了提示词。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's put the new product catalog there.
zh: 那我们就把新产品目录也放那里吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you would think that everything is working fine.
zh: 然后你会以为一切运转正常。

speaker: Unknown
en: Your model or your agent is still giving you product names that don't even exist.
zh: 但你的模型或你的智能体仍然在给你报一些根本不存在的产品名称。

speaker: Unknown
en: How did that happen?
zh: 这是怎么发生的?

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, the product catalog leaked into the weights when you fine-tuned it on your support tickets.
zh: 嗯,因为当你用支持工单微调时,产品目录已经泄漏进权重里了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that is the accident.

speaker: Unknown
en: Your architecture was accumulated.

speaker: Unknown
en: It was not designed.
zh: 它不是被设计出来的。

speaker: Unknown
en: That is the accident.
zh: 这就是那场事故。

speaker: Unknown
en: It is what six months of normal product work led to.
zh: 这就是六个月的正常产品工作所导致的结果。

speaker: Unknown
en: Nobody owned it, meaning everybody owned a piece of it.
zh: 没有人负责它，意思是每个人都拥有它的一部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: Nobody asked the diagnostic question.
zh: 没有人问过那个诊断性问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: Nobody asked where this thing should live.
zh: 没有人问过这个东西应该放在哪里。

speaker: Unknown
en: Those diagnostic questions are the lens we are going to talk about, and the rest of the talk is about the lens.
zh: 这些诊断性问题就是我们要讨论的透镜，演讲剩下的部分就是关于这个透镜的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the first part is prompt.
zh: 那么第一部分是 prompt。

speaker: Unknown
en: What is the job of the prompt?
zh: prompt 的职责是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: The job of the prompt is behavior, is tone, is the persona of the agent, things that are small, stable, and editable.
zh: prompt 的职责是行为、是语气、是智能体的角色设定，是那些小、稳定、可编辑的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: The wrong job for the prompt is to store facts.
zh: prompt 的错误职责是存储事实。

speaker: Unknown
en: You don't put product catalog into the prompt because you are unnecessarily providing context to your model.
zh: 你不要把产品目录放进 prompt 里，因为那是在不必要地向你的模型提供上下文，

speaker: Unknown
en: and paying the cost for it.
zh: 并为之付出代价。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when you have too many tokens, you run into lost in the middle problem.
zh: 而且当你有太多 token 时，你会遇到「迷失在中间」(lost in the middle) 问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: The diagnostic for prompt is, is the knowledge small, stable, and about how to behave rather than what to know?
zh: prompt 的诊断标准是：这个知识是否小、稳定，并且是关于如何表现而非关于知道什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: A concrete example for a good prompt use case is a customer support agent for a product SaaS, right?
zh: 一个好的 prompt 使用场景的具体例子，是一个面向 SaaS 产品的客户支持智能体，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, this agent has a professional tone.
zh: 这个智能体有专业的语气。

speaker: Unknown
en: It offers human escalation after three failures, and it provides you concrete next steps.
zh: 它在三次失败后提供人工升级，并且为你提供具体的下一步操作。

speaker: Unknown
en: None of this changes per query per user.
zh: 这些内容不会随每次查询、每个用户而改变。

speaker: Unknown
en: This exact thing belongs to the prompt.
zh: 正是这样东西属于 prompt。

speaker: Unknown
en: And one other thing is prompt is something, I'm not only talking about system prompt, I'm talking about authored instructions for your model.
zh: 另外一点是，prompt 是某种东西，我这里不只是在说 system prompt，我说的是你为你的模型撰写的指令。

speaker: Unknown
en: So they could also come from MD files, they could also come from other things, right?
zh: 所以它们也可能来自 MD 文件，也可能来自其他东西，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: But this is what I mean by prompt here.
zh: 但这就是我在这里所说的 prompt。

speaker: Unknown
en: The second path is memory.
zh: 第二条路径是 memory。

speaker: Unknown
en: The job of memory is to ground your model or your agent in
zh: memory 的职责是让你的模型或你的智能体立足于

speaker: Unknown
en: In knowledge, that is current, large, and sightable.
zh: 于那种是最新的、大量的、可溯源的知识。

speaker: Unknown
en: Current meaning it changes faster than you can fine-tune.
zh: 最新的意思是它的变化比你能微调的速度更快。

speaker: Unknown
en: It changes every now and then.
zh: 它时不时地变化。

speaker: Unknown
en: Large is because it cannot be held anywhere.
zh: 大量是因为它无法被存放在任何地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: It cannot be held in your prompt.
zh: 它无法被放进你的 prompt 里。

speaker: Unknown
en: And sightable because production AI systems need to be able to point to the source of the knowledge.
zh: 而可溯源是因为生产级 AI 系统需要能够指出知识的来源。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is what belongs to memory.
zh: 这就是属于 memory 的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, when I use the term memory, people think of agent memory, knowledge that is acquired about people, about a person who is interacting with the agent, right?
zh: 现在，当我使用 memory 这个词时，人们会想到智能体记忆，即关于人、关于正在与智能体交互的某个人所获取的知识，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: What I'm also referring to here is external memory.
zh: 我在这里指的还包括外部记忆。

speaker: Unknown
en: Which you retrieve using RAG and all that.
zh: 也就是你用 RAG 之类检索到的那些。

speaker: Unknown
en: The different policies, right?
zh: 各种不同的策略，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not being managed by your agent.
zh: 它不是由你的智能体来管理的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It is managed by an external application.
zh: 它是由一个外部应用来管理的。

speaker: Unknown
en: That is included here.
zh: 这也包含在内。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I'm talking both about the agent memory and the memory of the enterprise.
zh: 所以我说的既包括智能体的 memory，也包括企业的 memory。

speaker: Unknown
en: The wrong job for memory is shoving behavior in or thinking about how to reason.
zh: memory 的错误职责是硬塞行为进去，或者思考如何推理。

speaker: Unknown
en: With the memory.
zh: 利用 memory 来推理。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, of course, you can have a graphical kind of RAG which will help the agent do reasoning.
zh: 当然，你可以用图谱式的 RAG 来帮助智能体做推理。

speaker: Unknown
en: But that's it.
zh: 但仅此而已。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's where you stop.
zh: 那就是你的止步之处。

speaker: Unknown
en: For reasoning, you've got to have the right model.
zh: 至于推理，你必须有合适的模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because if your model cannot reason over two or three or five documents, it won't be able to reason over 50 that you provide.
zh: 因为如果你的模型无法对两三个或五个文档进行推理,那它也无法对你提供的 50 个文档进行推理。

speaker: Unknown
en: The more context doesn't help if it is not able to reason.
zh: 上下文再多也没有帮助，如果它没有能力推理的话。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the diagnostic or the question you need to ask is, is the knowledge too large to fit, changing faster than I can retrain?
zh: 所以诊断方法或者你需要问的问题是,这个知识是不是太大放不下,是不是变化得比我重新训练还快?

speaker: Unknown
en: And another important aspect is whether it has some access control, whether it is scope per user.
zh: 另一个重要的方面是它是否有某种访问控制,是否是按用户划分范围的。

speaker: Unknown
en: You have got to have that in memory.
zh: 你必须把它放在记忆里。

speaker: Unknown
en: If there is some kind of access control that this user cannot see the other person's information or the data or whatever, you've got to have that knowledge in memory because then you can control who sees what.
zh: 如果有某种访问控制,比如这个用户不能看到另一个人的信息或数据之类的,你就必须把那些知识放在记忆里,因为这样你才能控制谁看到什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: A good example for storing something in external memory or memory is a code assistant, which has access to all your repos as an organization.
zh: 把某些东西存到外部记忆或记忆里的一个好例子是代码助手,它可以访问你们组织的所有仓库。

en: So would you fine-tune your model to learn the code?

en: It's a simple one, right?
zh: 这是个简单的问题,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: You wouldn't do that.

speaker: Unknown
en: And would you stuff it in the prompt?
zh: 那你会把它塞进提示词里吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: No.
zh: 不会。

speaker: Unknown
en: You don't stuff such things into the prompt.
zh: 你不会把这类东西塞进提示词里。

speaker: Unknown
en: You may stuff or you may add certain things that are important in the context window.
zh: 你可能会塞,或者你可能会在上下文窗口中加入某些重要的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's something different.
zh: 那是另一回事。

speaker: Unknown
en: But you wouldn't stuff the entire code base into the prompt or even a part of it if it has no use there.
zh: 但你不会把整个代码库塞进提示词里,甚至在没用处的时候连一部分都不会塞。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now the other important thing is
zh: 现在另一个重要的事情是

speaker: Unknown
en: When you build a rack system, for your code, you need to make sure that you're chunking properly.
zh: 当你为你的代码构建一个 rack 系统时,你需要确保你正确地做了分块。

speaker: Unknown
en: You are using code-aware chunking with the AST, perhaps.
zh: 你可能在使用基于 AST 的、能感知代码结构的分块。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then the other important thing is use filtering.
zh: 然后另一个重要的事情是使用过滤。

speaker: Unknown
en: You should perhaps denormalize
zh: 你或许应该做反规范化

speaker: Unknown
en: Things such as, what is the repo this code is for?

speaker: Unknown
en: You get a code chunk, you have to create metadata about which repo it belongs to.

speaker: Unknown
en: What are the users who are allowed to commit?

speaker: Unknown
en: And all that, because that is what is going to help you get the exact data that you need versus creating a rag mush where you are returning a lot of chunks back from the database and then confusing the model.

speaker: Unknown
en: So again, the diagnostic is something that's too large to fit, changing the faster than you can retrain the model, and it's scoped at a certain level.
zh: 所以再说一次,诊断标准是:它太大放不下,它变化得比你重新训练模型还快,并且它是在某个层级上划定范围的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It could be a user, it could be a repo, whatever.

speaker: Unknown
en: All that knowledge belongs to memory.

speaker: Unknown
en: It could be external memory, which is your application's database, or it could be your agent memory as well.
zh: 它可以是外部记忆,也就是你的应用程序的数据库,也可以是你的智能体记忆。

en: That is what belongs to the weight.

en: No, that's not what you do all the time.

en: And what happens with that?

en: There is an issue.
